rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for putting an object somewhere out of sight.

example.english: I hide the snacks in the drawer.
example.traditional: 我將啲零食收埋喺櫃桶入面。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 di1 ling4 sik6 sau1 maai4 hai2 gwai6 tung2 jap6 min6

rows.note: Use this when a person hides themself, especially in a particular place.

example.english: You hide under the table, so I can't catch you.
example.traditional: 你匿埋喺張枱底，我捉唔到你。
example.jyutping: nei5 nei1 maai4 hai2 zoeng1 toi4 dai2 ngo5 zuk1 m4 dou2 nei5

rows.note: Use this shorter verb for hiding oneself when the context already makes the hiding place clear.

example.english: The police are coming, hide quickly!
example.jyutping: ging2 caat3 lei4 laa3 faai3 di1 nei1
